title: Add Deposit opens the work order dialog on the Finance tab
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user. That role holds every permission, including Part sales -> Create & Edit and Invoicing & payments -> Create & Edit.
  2. A test customer exists. If not: top menu Customers -> New Customer, enter a Name (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair") and click Save.
  3. A test vendor exists to order parts from. If not: top menu Parts -> Vendors (left sidebar) -> New Vendor, enter a Name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Parts Supply"), pick a value in Taxes (required, e.g. "GST"), then click Save & Close.
  4. Start a new part sale today (a sale started before this release handles cores the old way): top menu Parts -> Part Sales -> New Part Sale; in the New part sale dialog pick the Customer and click Save. The sale opens with the status Estimate.
  5. Add two parts on the Parts tab: in the Add Part dialog enter "Brake Pads" (Quantity 1, Sell Price $290.91, Vendor = the test vendor) and click Save & Add Part, then "Oil Filter" (Quantity 1, Sell Price $12.50) and click Save & Close. The sale reads Estimate.
  6. For the Declined step: on this build there is no Decline in a line's menu; the red Decline button above the parts list declines the sale at once (no confirmation) and it reads Declined. For the Approved and Complete checks: Authorize (green button) makes it Approved; ordering and receiving every part makes it Complete.
custom_steps:
1. On the Finance tab, find and click Add Deposit.
  2. Read the dialog fields and the pre-filled Memo; compare the number in the Memo with the sale number shown on the part sale (e.g. P9667-370).
  3. Confirm Add Deposit is available while the sale is Estimate, Approved or Complete.
  4. Take a deposit (e.g. $50.00). Then click the red Decline button above the parts list so the sale reads Declined; look for Add Deposit again and check the deposit already taken is still listed.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Finance tab shows Add Deposit; clicking it opens the same Create Deposit dialog a work order uses (Deposit Date, Payment Method, Deposit Amount, Reference Number, Memo).
  • The Memo pre-fills "Deposit for Part Sale " followed by the sale number exactly as the sale shows it (e.g. "Deposit for Part Sale P4-413").
  • Add Deposit is available while the sale is Estimate, Approved or Complete.
  • While the sale is Declined, Add Deposit is not offered, and the deposit already on the sale stays.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10269 (Take a deposit on a part sale); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 8; design canvas boards S8_*; read 5 Oct 2026 (specification edited that day). Source-verified 5 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R1: “The part sale Finance tab offers Add Deposit”
  • S8-R2: “The dialog is the one a work order uses, worded for a part sale, and the memo pre-fills with "Deposit for Part Sale " followed by the sale number exactly as the sale shows it, for example "Deposit for Part Sale P4-413"”
  • S8-R3: “A deposit can be added while the sale is Estimate, Approved or Complete”
  • S8-R3: “It is not offered while the sale is Declined; a deposit already on a declined sale stays”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
